summary.text: Jon Rosenthal represents Texas House District 135 in Northwest Houston, including Cypress and Katy, and is in his fourth term. He serves on the Energy Resources and Intergovernmental Affairs committees and is vice chair of the Redistricting Committee.

paragraphs.text: Rosenthal was born in 1963 at Stanford University Hospital and has lived in Texas since 1979.
He earned a Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering from the University of Texas at Austin in 1991.

He worked for over 25 years as a project manager, engineering manager and subsea systems engineer in and around the oil and gas industry, and earned a Graduate Certificate in Subsea Engineering from the University of Houston in 2016.
He received the Freshman of the Year award from the Legislative Study Group during the 86th session.
He and his wife, Aminta, have two adult children and have lived in Northwest Houston since 2007.
